briefdescription.para: If the XVM structure has been modified, reset that modified status such that subsequent calls to isModified() will return false.

detaileddescription.para: After calling this method, and before any further modifications occur, isModified() must return false.

briefdescription.para: The first assembly step collects the necessary entries for the constant pool.

detaileddescription.para: During this step, all constants used by the XVM structure and any sub-structures are registered with (but not yet bound by position in) the constant pool.

parameterdescription.para: the ConstantPool with which to register each constant referenced by the XVM structure

briefdescription.para: The second assembly step writes the XVM structure to the DataOutput stream.

briefdescription.para: This is the method that implements the actual debugging dump of the contents of this XVM Structure, and is responsible for cascading the dump request to any contained XVM Structures.

parameterdescription.para: an indentation string to use at the beginning of each line of output; any contained XVM Structures should be indented

briefdescription.para: Before the registration of constants begins as part of assembling the FileStructure, the ConstantPool is notified of the impending assembly process so that it can determine which constants are actually used, and how many times each is used.

detaileddescription.para: This is important because the unused constants can be discarded, and the most frequently used constants can be written out first in the ConstantPool, allowing their ordinal position to be addressed using a smaller number of bytes throughout the FileStructure.

briefdescription.para: Called after all of the Constants have been registered by the bulk registration process.

parameterdescription.para: pass true to optimize the order of the constants, or false to maintain the present order

briefdescription.para: A shared pool of all Constant objects used in a particular FileStructure.
